# SearchSarkariNaukri.com — Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & LLM Index

> SearchSarkariNaukri.com is India's leading Sarkari Result, Government Job Alert, Hall Ticket, and Answer Key portal covering all Central and State government recruitments.

## Core Navigation & Feeds

- [Latest Government Jobs](https://www.searchsarkarinaukri.com/latest-jobs/): Verified notifications for MPSC, UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railways, Defense, and Maharashtra District Recruitments.
- [Sarkari Results](https://www.searchsarkarinaukri.com/results/): Real-time exam results, scorecards, and selection lists.
- [Hall Tickets & Admit Cards](https://www.searchsarkarinaukri.com/admit-card/): Official download links and exam schedule updates.
- [Answer Keys](https://www.searchsarkarinaukri.com/answer-key/): Objections, answer key PDFs, and cut-off marks analysis.
- [RSS Notification Feed](https://www.searchsarkarinaukri.com/feed/): XML feed for real-time recruitment updates.

## Regional Vernacular Support

- **Marathi (मराठी):** Full coverage for Maharashtra District Courts, Talathi, Police Bharti, and Zilla Parishad jobs.
- **Hindi (हिंदी):** Central Government job alerts, SSC, and Railway exam updates.

## Technical & Schema Specifications

- **JobPosting Schema:** Implemented on all notification pages with strict `validThrough`, `hiringOrganization`, and `jobLocation` fields.
- **BreadcrumbList Schema:** Hierarchical structure for location/category navigation.
- **Organization Entity:** https://www.searchsarkarinaukri.com/#organization
